records.title: VUW Postgraduate International Scholarship
records.official_source: Te Herenga Waka — Victoria University of Wellington
records.deadline_display: Closing date(s): Same as the programme application closing date. A scholarship application is not required; students are assessed for eligibility on application for their programme.

records.title: DTU Tuition Fee Waiver for International non-EU/EEA MSc Students
records.deadline_display: "All non-EU/EEA students who apply by the 15 January deadline and who wish to apply for a tuition fee waiver must submit a separate personal statement with the application, clearly specifying that you are applying for the tuition fee waiver." DTU's important dates page for the autumn intake gives '15 January Application deadline - Non-EU' and 'April Tuition fee waivers announced - Non-EU'.
records.application_period: Please note that your application will not be processed until the application fee payment has been registered at DTU.

records.title: DCU International Scholarships for Non-EU Students
records.deadline_display: No separate scholarship deadline is published. Applicants are "automatically considered" for the scholarship when they apply as a non-EU student to DCU, so the relevant date is the course application deadline.
records.application_period: Awarded for the 2027-28 academic year, tied to the corresponding course application cycle.

records.title: Royal Society - Research Ireland University Research Fellowship
records.deadline_display: The 2027 round is listed as Status: Closed, with Open date 14 July 2026, Close date 09 September 2026 and Decision by 31 May 2027. No dates are published for the following round.
records.application_period: Annual competitive round. The 2027 cycle ran from 14 July 2026 to 9 September 2026, with decisions by 31 May 2027.
